<article class="work-item">
  <p class="work-type">Preprint · 2026</p>
  <h3 id="dg-dk-title">A discontinuous Galerkin approximation of the Dean-Kawasaki equation</h3>
  <p>We introduce a spatial dG approximation of the Dean-Kawasaki equation. The key ingredient is a general procedure for discretising multiplicative, divergence-form noise on finite element spaces whilst preserving its cross-variation structure.</p>
  <p class="work-venue"><strong>Kamran Arora</strong>, Federico Cornalba and Tony Shardlow</p>
